THE SMALL PRINT, IN PLAIN LANGUAGENO AUTOMATIC EXTRAS

Two feedback rounds.

A round is one consolidated list of changes to the agreed direction. A new direction or deliverable is a scope change, quoted before work starts.

1,200 NOK / hour.

For extra work you approve in writing. We estimate hours and agree a spending cap first. No extra hours are billed automatically.

50% / 50%.

For fixed-scope packages: half at kickoff, half before final handoff. Ongoing support is billed monthly in advance. Rights to final original work transfer after full payment, as specified in the agreement.

Third-party costs.

Fonts, stock, hosting, printing, paid tools and media spend are separate. We identify costs and licence restrictions before you approve them.

Source files included.

The editable final files listed in your package are part of the price. Unused concepts and third-party assets retain their own rights.

Custom work.

Multi-page sites, 3D films, research programmes and larger campaigns get an itemised quote. We explain what changes the price.
